<definition>

Compare the problem itself, not the product area. A spike that is unstarted or in progress is not shipped.
Fail if a completed story solves the same problem, or a roadmap item already covers it.

response.content: {"critique": "I checked Shortcut story 4127, 'Bulk upload documents to a claim,' which is the most similar item (0.143). It is marked completed (completed_at 2026-10-06) and its description states 'Users can now upload multiple documents at once to a claim in Keelwater, streamlining the process and reducing manual effort for claims handlers.' This directly solves the same core problem described in the opportunity statement—individually uploading documents causing delays and administrative burden.
